title: Sequential Grid Path Cover
summary: A grid contains each label 1 through k once; all other cells are zero. Find a four-direction path visiting every cell exactly once and encountering the labeled cells in increasing label order. Start anywhere. Return its complete coordinate sequence, or an empty list if impossible; any valid path is accepted.
